title: Repair character-option and core-rule source semantics needed by real consumers
description:
Own known character-option/core-rule projection defects. Repair source-fidelity problems
such as option-local alternatives, resource/reset/scaling data, structured grants, and
rule/action/condition relationships. Add structured semantics where they preserve source
structure, improve discovery, or feed a positively selected deterministic capability.
Do not require universal deterministic execution.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known findings in this domain receive explicit source-fidelity/discovery/capability/state dispositions and repairs.
- Structured alternatives remain option-local and cannot be flattened into cumulative effects.
- Source-derived resource/reset/scaling/grant data is accurate wherever projected or consumed deterministically.
- Positive capability inputs are sufficient for the operations that consume them and expose their limits.
- No criterion requires exhaustive semantic classification or deterministic execution of all domain clauses.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
